@everyone CHARITY STREAM FOR LINDEN COMMUNITY PANTRY — SATURDAY, NOV 21, 10AM–10PM

Posting this EARLY because last year half the server didn’t know until basically the day of, and we raised $212. This year the goal is $600, and rook is matching the first $100 donated, so that first $100 counts double.

Donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz

Donations go straight to the pantry, with nothing taken off. Through their wholesale partner, every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food. They’re serving around 340 families a week right now, and the shelves are low going into Thanksgiving. Even $3 genuinely helps—but please don’t feel bad if you can’t donate. You’re still welcome to hang out all day.

WHAT CHAT GETS:
$100 = I play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 = chat picks my hair dye color and I dye it ON STREAM
$400 = one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 = I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry; donations go to them and they purchase the food

Games: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join and I’ll drop the code. Second half, chat votes on what I play every 2 hours. No repeat maps, Larry.

No card? You can still help by sharing this, showing up, joining the games, and keeping chat alive. If you’re local, you can also drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays, 9–1.

I’m pinning this so nobody misses it this time. Nov 21. Be there or watch me dye my hair alone.
